reviewType: Targeted independent verification of the frozen R2-POLICY-001 documentation correction only

checks.name: Nullable application policy maps to true absence
checks.evidence: C8 allows null or the closed true-flag object. C12 explicitly maps null by omitting ObservationConfig.applicationPolicy, never forwarding null or synthesizing a false object. This matches the optional property in observationTypes and the observationSanitizer presence guard.

checks.name: Present application policy and grants match unchanged loader
checks.evidence: Present object requires allowStructuralDiscovery:true and readGrants[0..32]. C1 and C12 repeat the32-grant cap, require a read capability/type set and globally unique policyRuleId within the complete grant list, independent of selector differences. observationSanitizer.ts23-35 enforces these conditions.

checks.name: Field-only and optional override behavior preserved
checks.evidence: rules remains independent. C12 permits shared policyRuleId across otherwise valid FieldOverrides while requiring unique testId, matching accessibleName/name and allowing omitted accessibleName only for permittedBusinessData. No new cross-override global policyRuleId restriction. Existing collector override precedence/structuralOnly denial/sensitive-source checks remain unchanged.

checks.name: Region grants remain optional author-independent configuration
checks.evidence: The correction does not require per-control mappings, widen read permission or modify collector priority/conflict/eligibility semantics. Application/region grant behavior remains the already-reviewed R2 behavior.
